tickets.title: Prepare Refinance vs Adjustable Comparison Including HELOC Options
tickets.text: Prepare a side‑by‑side comparison of the adjustable‑rate mortgage after reset versus the fixed‑rate refinance option, including HELOC integration, for Liora Nettlewhisk and Jonah Nettlewhisk. Incorporate payment estimates, closing costs, and cash reserve impact as discussed.

tickets.text: Collect the required lender documents—current pay stub for Liora Nettlewhisk, Jonah Nettlewhisk’s year‑to‑date profit‑and‑loss statement, the most recent business bank statement, and the complete prior‑year tax return packet—and finalize the refinance packet. Ensure all items are uploaded for Silver Marmot Mortgage review.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action. Apply this review to Liora Nettlewhisk’s Clockwork Clover Systems stock held in the joint taxable brokerage account (approximately $156,000 with a $42,000 cost basis) and compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged‑asset, and no‑sale scenarios for debt reduction.

tickets.title: Address Appraisal and Rate‑Lock Readiness Items
tickets.text: Gather and submit the appraisal and rate‑lock readiness items for Liora Nettlewhisk’s refinance—including the insurance declarations, property tax bill, and HOA confirmation—by the required deadline to keep the loan officer’s rate‑lock window open.

tickets.title: Produce Non‑Retirement Funding Options Analysis
tickets.text: Prepare an analysis for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk that outlines non‑retirement funding options for debt restructuring, ensuring retirement account withdrawals are only considered as a last‑resort scenario, and deliver the report by the target date.
tickets.evidence: the agreed planning analysis is to show non-retirement funding options before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario by 2025-02-03.
